name: levee
description: LEVee: pays local responders through PayPal before a hurricane lands. AI advises, fixed rules decide, PayPal pays.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend/payments install && npm --prefix backend/policy install && npm --prefix backend/agents install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.check:backend: npm --prefix backend/payments run typecheck && npm --prefix backend/payments test && npm --prefix backend/policy run typecheck && npm --prefix backend/policy test && npm --prefix backend/agents run typecheck && npm --prefix backend/agents test
scripts.check:frontend: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && node --test src/server/*.test.ts src/components/pledge/*.test.ts
